label: Alpine Leaderboard
description: Alpine leaderboard — friendly mobile-marketing card: a ranked list with gold/silver/bronze rank badges, names, count-up values, and a soft podium tint. Standalone Alpine brand flavor.

items.label: Items
items.description: Leaderboard rows. Each: name, value, optional Display label + color. Auto-sorted by value unless preSorted.

preSorted.label: Pre-sorted
preSorted.description: Keep input order instead of auto-sorting by value (desc).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): rows cascade in via alpha fade — a geq per faded leaf. "light": the same via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

anim.countUp.label: Count up
anim.countUp.description: Count each value up on intro.

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the board — rows GREEN with the measured rule when all equal-size, offenders RED when not. Deterministic false default; production never sets it.
